Zurich North America is currently hiring a UA Associate or UA Analyst – Construction Property to join the Construction Property team in our Denver office!

At Zurich North America we acknowledge that work life-balance and flexibility are a priority when it comes to choosing your next career move. Designed with our employees' needs in mind, the ZNA hybrid work model emphasizes flexibility, allowing employees to conduct individual work in their preferred location, while facilitating in-person connections and collaborative activities when meaningful and valuable. While the model provides a high level of flexibility and autonomy, occasional circumstances requiring in-office attendance should be expected.

This is a hybrid work position, however, the candidate selected for this opportunity should be able to report into one of the following North American office locations: Denver, CO

As a UA Associate or UA Analyst – Construction Property, you will support and work closely with experienced Underwriters in the review and analysis of risks. You will enjoy the opportunity to fully apply and hone your research and analytical skills to effectively assess risk and grow your career.

In this role you will be responsible for:

- Reviews, evaluates, and summarizes risk exposures, controls, loss history, and financial condition to aid underwriting decisions around submission acceptance or declination.

- Follows instructions from Underwriters in areas of policy rating, subjective pricing, policy construction, coverages & exclusions, mandatory forms, etc. to accurately quote and issue policies.

- Provides account servicing support in collaboration with Underwriter and Manager, with responsibility for end-to-end servicing processes for new business, renewals, and endorsements for basic to moderately complex business and products.

- Responds to written, verbal telephone inquiries appropriately and on time under close supervision by Underwriter and/or Manager. Working collaboratively with assigned underwriters.

- Supports Underwriter with broker/agent/distributor/customer interactions by providing basic customer service skills.

The role will be filled at the UA Associate or UA Analyst level. The hiring manager will determine the appropriate level based upon the selected applicant’s experience and skill set relative to the qualifications listed for this position.

UA Associate – Construction Property Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree and no prior experience in the Administrative, Customer Service, Financial Services, Risk Management, or Insurance area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice, including Associate Degree and no prior experience in the Administrative, Customer Service, Financial Services, Risk Management, or Insurance area
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 2 or more years of experience in the Administrative, Customer Service, Financial Services, Risk Management, or Insurance area
AND

- Knowledge of data collection and analysis

- Microsoft Office experience

OR

UA Analyst – Construction Property Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree and 2 or more years of experience in the Insurance, Underwriting, Finance, Accounting or Banking area.
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice, including Associates Degree and 2 or mor years of experience in the Insurance, Underwriting, Finance, Accounting or Banking area.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 4 or more years of experience in the Insurance, Underwriting, Insurance, Underwriting, Finance, Accounting or Banking area.
AND

- Knowledge of the insurance industry and the legal and regulatory environment.

- Experience with data collection and analysis

- Experience with processing, rating and policy management systems used in the insurance industry. Knowledge of processing, rating and policy management systems used in the insurance or financial industry.

- Customer service experience

- Problem solving experience

- Experience servicing product portfolios for multiple lines of business for insurance or financial industry.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Insurance industry knowledge

- Knowledge of processing, rating and policy management systems used in the insurance industry

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

- Superior skills in relationship building, active listening with customers and coworkers

- Enjoys working with details and providing accurate data in a timely manner

- Self-directed to meet deadlines

- Multi-tasking skills

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The combined salary range for this position is $54,500.00 - $98,100.00. The proposed hourly rate for the UA Associate is $26.20- $42.84, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 5%. The proposed salary range for the UA Analyst is $60,000.00 - $98,100.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Location: Cumbria

Salary: Total Package value of over £65,000, including a competitive salary of up to £57,594, depending on experience.

Car: Essential Car User

So what’s it all about:

At Zurich, our Engineer Surveyor workforce is central to our continued success, being the ‘Face of Zurich’ to our large and varied client base. You’ll find a fully flexible offering that means you can manage your own diary to service your own client area. This will allow you to broker and develop your relationships whilst representing Zurich Engineering.

No two days will ever be the same, as you’ll work in a variety of interesting environments and you will have control over your own work/life balance, as we believe our people are what makes us successful.

Our Engineer Surveyor roles allow you to develop your mechanical engineering skills further and work for a market-leading engineering inspection provider.

Zurich Engineering is looking to expand our highly skilled, field-based, Engineer Surveyor team, and we currently have a vaca ncy for the Cumbria area for a Lift and Crane Eng ineer Surveyor.

What will I be doing?

You’ll start with our industry-leading, bespoke training and move swiftly to carrying out hands-on statutory inspections, providing your expert opinion on a wide range of equipment, enabling our clients to comply with all relevant legislation and to the exacting standards both we and our clients demand. Following your inspection, we’ll need you to report back using a rugged laptop, and then issue electronically to our clients, so good IT skills and high levels of literacy are required. You will be an excellent communicator, and confident in your ability to make sound engineering judgements.

What skills/qualifications will I have?

You will be an experienced engineer with a sound knowledge of your engineering discipline and be part of our multi-disciplined inspection team within your geographic area. You will report to a Team Manager and be based from home, with your client base a reasonable travelling distance from your home.

Because this role is SAFed governed, we need you to ideally have obtained:

- Ideally a Level 4 qualification (HND / HNC etc.) in a relevant engineering field, minimum level 3 – training will be offered to bring you up to competency and qualification level

- Either a time served or Modern Apprenticeship

- Hands-on experience in a relevant engineering discipline

- A background in working with lifts and/or crane equipment would be an advantage, with hands on experience of working in a role such as manufacturing / repair / maintenance / mechanical / motor trade.

- A full valid UK driving licence.

- Be willing and able to work paid overtime.

As an inclusive employer we want to ensure that all candidates feel comfortable and are able to perform at their best during the interview. You’ll have the opportunity to let us know of any reasonable adjustment or practical support needed when you apply.

What will you get in return?

Everyone’s different. That’s why at Zurich, we offer a wide range of employee benefits so our people can choose what fits them and their life. Our benefits provide real flexibility so our people can make considered choices and tailor their benefits throughout the year. Our benefits include 12% defined non-contributory pension scheme, annual company bonus, private medical insurance and the option to buy up to an additional 20 days or sell some of your holiday.

Follow the link for more information about our benefits - Employee benefits | Working at Zurich Insurance UK

Who we are:

At Zurich we aspire to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world and the best global insurer. Together we’re creating a brighter future for our customers, our people and our planet.

With over 55,000 employees in more than 170 countries , you’ll feel the support of being part of a strong and stable company who are a long-standing player in the insurance industry.

We’ve made a promise to each other and every employee; to focus on sustainable impact, to care about each other’s wellbeing, to use our diverse expertise to be curious and optimistic and to develop the skills needed for our future.

If you're interested in working in a dynamic and challenging environment for a company that recognises and rewards your creativity, initiatives and contributions - then Zurich could be just the place for you. Be part of something great.

Our Culture

At Zurich, our sense of community is strong and we’re particularly passionate about diversity and inclusion, which we’ve won numerous awards for. We want our people to bring the whole of themselves to work and ensure everybody is made to feel welcome, regardless of their background, beliefs or culture. We want our employees to reflect the diversity of our customers, and so are committed to treating all of our applicants fairly and with respect, irrespective of their actual or assumed background, disability or any other protected characteristic.

We’ve an environment that places a real importance on our people’s wellbeing from a physical, mental, social and financial perspective. We work with our wellbeing partners and industry experts to provide the best advice and access to a wealth of lifestyle support. We’re also committed to continuous improvement and we offer access to a comprehensive range of training and development opportunities.

We’re passionate about supporting employees to help others by getting involved in volunteering, charitable and community activity. Our charitable arm, Zurich Community Trust, is one of the longest-established corporate trusts in the UK. In that time, we’ve awarded grants and volunteered time to deserving causes in the UK valued at over £90 million.

So make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported, Love what you do. Work for us.

A Zurigo, la nostra forza lavoro di Ingegnere Surveyor è centrale per il nostro continuo successo, essendo la ‘Face of Zurich’ alla nostra grande e variegata base clienti. Troverete un'offerta completamente flessibile che significa che è possibile gestire il proprio diario per servire la propria area cliente. Questo vi permetterà di mediare e sviluppare le vostre relazioni mentre rappresentate l'ingegneria di Zurigo.

Nessun due giorni sarà mai lo stesso, come si lavorerà in una varietà di ambienti interessanti e si avrà il controllo sul proprio equilibrio lavoro / vita, come crediamo che la nostra gente è ciò che ci rende di successo.

I nostri ruoli di Ingegnere Surveyor consentono di sviluppare ulteriormente le tue capacità di ingegneria meccanica e di lavorare per un fornitore di ispezione di ingegneria leader di mercato.

Zurigo Engineering sta cercando di espandere il nostro team di ingegneri altamente qualificato e basato sul campo, e attualmente abbiamo un posto vacante per l'area Cumbria per un Lift e Crane Eng ineer Surveyor.

Cosa faro'?

Potrai iniziare con la nostra formazione leader del settore, formazione su misura e muoversi rapidamente per eseguire le ispezioni legali hands-on, fornendo la tua opinione esperta su una vasta gamma di attrezzature, consentendo ai nostri clienti di rispettare tutte le leggi pertinenti e per gli standard esigenti sia noi che i nostri clienti richiedono. Dopo la vostra ispezione, avremo bisogno di riferire indietro utilizzando un computer portatile robusto, e poi emettere elettronicamente ai nostri clienti, così buone competenze IT e alti livelli di alfabetizzazione sono necessari. Sarete un eccellente comunicatore, e fiducioso nella vostra capacità di fare giudizi di ingegneria sana.

Quali competenze/qualifica ho?

Sarete un ingegnere esperto con una solida conoscenza della vostra disciplina di ingegneria e far parte del nostro team di ispezione multi-disciplinata all'interno della vostra area geografica. Ti riferirai a un Team Manager e sarai basato da casa, con la tua base clienti a una distanza di viaggio ragionevole da casa tua.

Poiché questo ruolo è governato da SAFed, abbiamo bisogno che tu abbia ottenuto idealmente:

- Idealmente una qualifica di livello 4 (HND / HNC ecc) in un campo di ingegneria rilevante, livello minimo 3 - formazione sarà offerto per portare fino a livello di competenza e qualifica

- O un tempo servito o Modern Apprenticeship

- Esperienza pratica in una disciplina ingegneristica rilevante

- Un background di lavoro con ascensori e/o gru attrezzature sarebbe un vantaggio, con mani su esperienza di lavoro in un ruolo come la produzione / riparazione / manutenzione / meccanica / commercio del motore.

- Una patente di guida del Regno Unito.

- Essere disposti e in grado di lavorare pagato straordinario.

Come datore di lavoro inclusivo vogliamo garantire che tutti i candidati si sentano a proprio agio e siano in grado di eseguire al meglio durante l'intervista. Avrete la possibilità di farci sapere qualsiasi ragionevole adeguamento o supporto pratico necessario quando si applica.

Cosa otterrai in cambio?

Ognuno è diverso. Ecco perché a Zurigo offriamo una vasta gamma di vantaggi per i nostri dipendenti in modo che i nostri utenti possano scegliere ciò che si adatta a loro e alla loro vita. I nostri vantaggi offrono una reale flessibilità in modo che le nostre persone possano fare scelte considerate e adattare i loro benefici durante tutto l'anno. I nostri benefici includono il 12% di pensione non contributiva definita, bonus annuale dell'azienda, assicurazione medica privata e la possibilità di acquistare fino a un ulteriore 20 giorni o vendere alcuni della vostra vacanza.

A Zurigo aspiriamo ad essere una delle aziende più responsabili e d'impatto del mondo e il migliore assicuratore globale. Insieme stiamo creando un futuro più luminoso per i nostri clienti, la nostra gente e il nostro pianeta.

Con oltre 55.000 dipendenti in più di 170 paesi, sentirete il supporto di essere parte di una società forte e stabile che sono un giocatore di lunga data nel settore assicurativo.

Abbiamo fatto una promessa l’uno all’altro e ogni dipendente; per concentrarsi sull’impatto sostenibile, per prendersi cura del benessere degli altri, per utilizzare le nostre diverse competenze per essere curiosi e ottimisti e per sviluppare le competenze necessarie per il nostro futuro.

Se sei interessato a lavorare in un ambiente dinamico e stimolante per un'azienda che riconosce e premia la tua creatività, iniziative e contributi - allora Zurigo potrebbe essere il posto giusto per te. Fai parte di qualcosa di grande.

La nostra cultura

A Zurigo, il nostro senso di comunità è forte e siamo particolarmente appassionati di diversità e inclusione, per cui abbiamo vinto numerosi premi. Vogliamo che il nostro popolo porti tutto il loro lavoro e assicuri che tutti siano accolti, indipendentemente dal loro background, dalle loro convinzioni o dalla loro cultura. Vogliamo che i nostri dipendenti riflettano la diversità dei nostri clienti, e così si impegnano a trattare tutti i nostri candidati in modo equo e rispettoso, indipendentemente dal loro reale o presunto background, disabilità o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta.

Abbiamo un ambiente che pone una reale importanza sul benessere della nostra gente da una prospettiva fisica, mentale, sociale e finanziaria. Lavoriamo con i nostri partner di benessere e gli esperti del settore per fornire i migliori consigli e l'accesso a una ricchezza di supporto allo stile di vita. Ci impegniamo anche a un miglioramento continuo e offriamo l’accesso a una gamma completa di opportunità di formazione e sviluppo.

Siamo appassionati di sostenere i dipendenti per aiutare gli altri, coinvolgendoci nell’attività di volontariato, caritativa e comunitaria. Il nostro braccio caritativo, Zurich Community Trust, è uno dei più consolidati trust aziendali nel Regno Unito. Worum geht es also:

Bei Zurich ist unsere Engineer Surveyor Belegschaft von zentraler Bedeutung für unseren anhaltenden Erfolg und das „Face of Zurich für unseren großen und vielfältigen Kundenstamm. Sie werden ein völlig flexibles Angebot finden, das bedeutet, dass Sie Ihr eigenes Tagebuch verwalten können, um Ihren eigenen Kundenbereich zu bedienen. Dies ermöglicht es Ihnen, Ihre Beziehungen zu vermitteln und zu entwickeln, während Sie Zurich Engineering vertreten.

Keine zwei Tage werden jemals die gleichen sein, da Sie in einer Vielzahl von interessanten Umgebungen arbeiten und die Kontrolle über Ihre eigene Work-Life-Balance haben, da wir glauben, dass unsere Mitarbeiter das sind, was uns erfolgreich macht.

Unsere Engineer Surveyor Rollen ermöglichen es Ihnen, Ihre Fähigkeiten im Maschinenbau weiterzuentwickeln und für einen marktführenden Anbieter von Inspektionen zu arbeiten.

Zurich Engineering ist bestrebt, unser hochqualifiziertes, feldbasiertes Engineer Surveyor-Team zu erweitern, und wir haben derzeit einen Vaca ncy für den Cumbria-Bereich für einen Lift and Crane Eng Ineer Surveyor.

Was werde ich tun?

Sie beginnen mit unserem branchenführenden, maßgeschneiderten Training und gehen schnell zu praktischen gesetzlichen Inspektionen über, geben Ihr Expertengutachten zu einer breiten Palette von Geräten und ermöglichen es unseren Kunden, alle relevanten Gesetze und die anspruchsvollen Standards einzuhalten, die sowohl wir als auch unsere Kunden verlangen. Nach Ihrer Inspektion müssen Sie sich mit einem robusten Laptop melden und dann elektronisch an unsere Kunden ausstellen, so dass gute IT-Kenntnisse und ein hohes Maß an Alphabetisierung erforderlich sind. Sie werden ein ausgezeichneter Kommunikator sein und auf Ihre Fähigkeit vertrauen, fundierte technische Urteile zu fällen.

Welche Fähigkeiten/Qualifikationen werde ich haben?

Sie werden ein erfahrener Ingenieur mit fundierten Kenntnissen Ihrer Ingenieurdisziplin sein und Teil unseres multidisziplinären Inspektionsteams in Ihrem geografischen Gebiet sein. Sie berichten einem Teammanager und sind von zu Hause aus ansässig, wobei Ihre Kundenbasis eine angemessene Reiseentfernung von Ihrem Zuhause hat.

Da diese Rolle SAFed regiert wird, müssen Sie idealerweise Folgendes erhalten haben:

- Idealerweise eine Stufe 4 Qualifikation (HND / HNC etc.) in einem relevanten Engineering-Bereich, Mindeststufe 3 - Ausbildung wird angeboten, um Sie auf Kompetenz und Qualifikationsniveau zu bringen

- Entweder eine Zeit serviert oder moderne Lehre

- Hands-on Erfahrung in einer relevanten Ingenieurdisziplin

- Ein Hintergrund in der Arbeit mit Aufzügen und / oder Kranausrüstung wäre ein Vorteil, mit praktischen Erfahrungen in einer Rolle wie Herstellung / Reparatur / Wartung / mechanischer / motorischer Handel.

- Einen voll gültigen britischen Führerschein.

- Seien Sie bereit und in der Lage, bezahlte Überstunden zu machen.

Als inklusiver Arbeitgeber möchten wir sicherstellen, dass sich alle Kandidaten wohl fühlen und während des Interviews ihre besten Leistungen erbringen können. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, uns jede angemessene Anpassung oder praktische Unterstützung mitzuteilen, die bei Ihrer Bewerbung erforderlich ist.

Was bekommen Sie im Gegenzug?

Jeder ist anders. Deshalb bieten wir in Zürich ein breites Spektrum an Mitarbeiterleistungen, damit unsere Mitarbeiter wählen können, was zu ihnen und ihrem Leben passt. Unsere Vorteile bieten echte Flexibilität, damit unsere Mitarbeiter überlegte Entscheidungen treffen und ihre Vorteile das ganze Jahr über anpassen können. Unsere Leistungen umfassen 12% beitragsunabhängige Altersvorsorge, jährlichen Unternehmensbonus, private Krankenversicherung und die Option, bis zu 20 Tage mehr zu kaufen oder einen Teil Ihres Urlaubs zu verkaufen.

Wir haben uns gegenseitig und jedem Mitarbeiter ein Versprechen gegeben, uns auf nachhaltige Auswirkungen zu konzentrieren, uns um das Wohlergehen des anderen zu kümmern, unser vielfältiges Fachwissen zu nutzen, um neugierig und optimistisch zu sein und die Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die für unsere Zukunft erforderlich sind.

Wir sind auch der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung verpflichtet und bieten Zugang zu einem umfassenden Angebot an Schulungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Wir sind leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, Mitarbeiter dabei zu unterstützen, anderen zu helfen, indem wir uns in Freiwilligenarbeit, gemeinnützigen und gemeinschaftlichen Aktivitäten engagieren. Alors qu'est-ce que c'est :

À Zurich, la main-d'œuvre de l'Ingénieur Surveyor est au cœur de notre succès continu, étant la «Face de Zurich» pour notre vaste clientèle variée. Vous trouverez une offre entièrement flexible qui signifie que vous pouvez gérer votre propre journal pour servir votre propre zone client. Cela vous permettra de négocier et de développer vos relations tout en représentant Zurich Engineering.

Pas deux jours ne seront jamais les mêmes, car vous travaillerez dans une variété d'environnements intéressants et vous aurez le contrôle sur votre propre équilibre travail/vie personnelle, car nous croyons que nos gens sont ce qui nous fait réussir.

Nos rôles d'arpenteur ingénieur vous permettent de développer vos compétences en génie mécanique et de travailler pour un fournisseur d'inspection d'ingénierie leader sur le marché.

Zurich Engineering cherche à développer notre équipe d'Ingénieur Surveyor, hautement qualifiée et basée sur le terrain, et nous disposons actuellement d'un vaca ncy pour la région de Cumbria pour un télésiège et une grue eng ineer Surveyor.

Que vais-je faire ?

Vous commencerez par notre formation sur mesure, leader de l'industrie, et passerez rapidement à la réalisation d'inspections légales pratiques, fournissant votre avis d'expert sur un large éventail d'équipements, permettant à nos clients de se conformer à toute la législation pertinente et aux normes exigeantes que nous et nos clients exigeons. Après votre inspection, nous avons besoin que vous rapportiez à l'aide d'un ordinateur portable robuste, puis de délivrer électroniquement à nos clients, de bonnes compétences en TI et des niveaux élevés de littératie sont nécessaires. Vous serez un excellent communicateur, et confiant dans votre capacité à faire des jugements d'ingénierie solide.

Quelles compétences/qualifications dois-je posséder?

Vous serez un ingénieur expérimenté avec une bonne connaissance de votre discipline d'ingénierie et faites partie de notre équipe d'inspection multidisciplinaire dans votre région géographique. Vous ferez rapport à un gestionnaire d'équipe et serez basé de la maison, avec votre base de clients à une distance raisonnable de votre maison.

Parce que ce rôle est régi par SAFed, nous avons besoin que vous ayez idéalement obtenu:

- Idéalement une qualification de niveau 4 (HND / HNC, etc.) dans un domaine d'ingénierie pertinent, niveau minimum 3 – une formation vous sera offerte pour vous amener au niveau de compétence et de qualification
